questionVi: The given state machine shows the behavior of a beverage dispenser, e.g., for soft drinks or coffee. questionEn: Which of the following is a benefit of early stakeholder feedback?
questionVi: Which of the following is a benefit of early stakeholder feedback?

options.en: A. It can be gathered early and then used to make changes after the product goes to production to make it more user friendly
options.vi: A. It can be gathered early and then used to make changes after the product goes to production to make it more user friendly

options.vi: B. It allows the project manager to get a better view of the changes that will be needed for the next version

options.en: C. The developers get a better understanding of what they are building
options.vi: C. The developers get a better understanding of what they are building

options.vi: D. The testers get a better understanding of the test automation requirements

correctEn: C. The developers get a better understanding of what they are building
correctVi: C. The developers get a better understanding of what they are building
explanation: Refer 3.2.1. Benefits of Early and Frequent Stakeholder Feedback. Lợi ích của phản hồi sớm, A sai vì 'changes after the product goes to production' là thay đổi đc tạo ra sau khi sản phẩm lên production là quá muộn, tương tự B sai vì quá muộn "changes that will be needed for the next version" next version cũng là lần release sau rồi. B đúng vì "a better understanding" hiểu biết về cái gì cần phải xây dựng tốt hơn. C sai vì "test automation requirements" yêu cầu về test automation thì là trách nhiệm của tester rồi, ko liên quan đến stakeholder feedback Cau hoi 9
